program:
PARAMS = {
    "L1":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),      # NMOS common-source length
    "I1":    (56e-6, 44e-6, 62e-6),  # common-source bias current (sets gm1 for GBW)
    "VDS1":  (0.7, 0.55, 0.9),       # target output DC level
    "RDC":   (6.5e4, 5.0e4, 9.0e4),  # pull-down resistor; sets conductance G for f3dB
    "gmid2": (10.0, 9.0, 12.0),      # PMOS load/reference gm/Id
    "L2":    (0.25, 0.25, 0.3),      # PMOS load/reference length (same on M2 and M3)
    "IREF":  (3e-6, 2.5e-6, 4e-6),   # PMOS reference current (M3 diode)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I1 = p["I1"]
    VDS1 = p["VDS1"]
    RDC = p["RDC"]
    IREF = p["IREF"]
    L1 = p["L1"]
    L2 = p["L2"]
    VGS1 = 0.75

    # PMOS load mirror: M3 is the unit diode, M2 is K times the unit.
    # KCL at the output: I2 = I1 + VDS1/RDC
    opr = lut.size("p", p["gmid2"], L2, IREF, vds=0.9)
    W_unit = opr.W
    I2_target = I1 + VDS1 / RDC
    K = I2_target / IREF                      # continuous width ratio
    op2 = lut.op("p", W_unit * K, L2, opr.vgs, VDD - VDS1)
    I2 = op2["Id"]

    # Common-source NMOS: gate fixed at VGS1, width sized to carry I1 at VDS1
    t = lut.op("n", 10.0, L1, VGS1, VDS1)
    W1 = 10.0 * I1 / t["Id"]
    op1 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, VGS1, VDS1)

    # NMOS sink mirror for the PMOS bias: M0 diode at iref, M4 scaled to sink IREF
    op0 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    W4 = op0.W * IREF / iref
    L0 = 1.0

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)
    n.M("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W_unit * K, L2)
    n.dev("M3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", opr)
    n.M("M4", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W4, L0)
    n.dev("M0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", op0)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "vss", RDC)

    gm1 = op1["gm"]
    gds1 = op1["gds"]
    gds2 = op2["gds"]
    G = gds1 + gds2 + 1.0 / RDC
    gain = gm1 / G
    f3db = G / (2 * PI * cl)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cl)
    power = VDD * (I2 + iref + IREF)
    swing = (VDD - opr.vdsat) - op1["vdsat"]

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(gain),
        "f3dB": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": VDS1,
        "swing": swing,
    }
